headline: European Automakers Seek 'Made in EU' Exemptions for Türkiye Plants
summary: European automakers requested exemptions for their manufacturing plants in Türkiye under proposed 'Made in EU' rules, warning exclusion threatens investments.
why: Trade regulations and local content rules significantly impact cross-border manufacturing investments and supply chain competitiveness in the automotive industry.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Automakers seek exemptions for plants located in Türkiye.
